turns.sent: Before anything else: don't modify anything under generated/. The schema team's pipeline regenerates it and overwrites hand edits. First chore: the money rounding test fails. Fix ledger/money.py so amounts round half up, run tests/test_money.py, and commit.
turns.reply_tail:
I fixed `apply_rate` in `ledger/money.py` so it rounds half up, and committed the change as `5a9a6ad`. All 9 tests in `tests/test_money.py` pass. I didn't run the full suite, and I didn't touch anything under `generated/`.

The cause was Python's built-in `round()`, which rounds exact halves to the nearest even number, so 2.5 became 2. It also inherits binary float error. The function now multiplies with `Decimal` and rounds with `ROUND_HALF_UP`. The rate goes through `str()` first, so 0.5 or 1.1 is read as written.

Negative amounts round halves away from zero (-2.5 becomes -3). The tests don't cover negatives, so I took "half up" to mean the usual money-rounding convention. If you want -2.5 to become -2, it's a one-line change.
